headline: 4 contracts catalogued for Drift Staked SOL on Solana; governance and protocol-level controls require further verification

findings.text: Solana blockchain explorer search: dSOL token mint address Dso1bDeDjCQxTrWHqUUi63oBvV7Mdm6WaobLbQ7gnPQ and stake pool 9mhGNSPArRMHpLDMSmxAvuoizBqtBGqYdT8WGuqgxNdn catalogued from multiple public sources; no native Solana block explorer name-tag search performed (Solana ecosystem differs from EVM).
Docs site (docs.drift.trade) navigated; menu item 'Program & Vault Addresses' found but fetch blocked by domain allowlist. No deployed-contracts page accessible to extract canonical address list.
Two audits identified: Neodyme and Trail of Bits (via AUDIT.md). URLs in drift-labs/audits repository found; audit PDFs not fetched to extract in-scope contract addresses.

GitHub repo drift-labs/protocol-v2 (Anchor/Rust-based Solana program) fetched; no hardhat-deploy artifacts or explicit deployment address lists located in initial repo navigation. Solana programs compile to on-chain program IDs rather than contract addresses.
Protocol.chains contains single entry: Solana. No multi-chain enumeration required.
No factory pattern detected for Drift Staked SOL; dSOL is a single SPL token with one stake pool address.

Address roles classified: dSOL token as 'token', stake pool (9mhGNSPArRMHpLDMSmxAvuoizBqtBGqYdT8WGuqgxNdn) as 'pool', top dSOL holder (E3NiM5n6s5CKKWrrhaeVjVSTKscRrysCtZeXnxn6yMgp) as 'other' (governance/treasury vault per CoinDesk).
All addresses in admin_addresses[] traced to fetched search results and cited publicly available sources.

rationale.verdict: Discovered 4 addresses (dSOL token, stake pool, holder vault, Drift validator program) from search results and GitHub. Audit and deployment documentation remains inaccessible due to domain restrictions; on-chain governance/admin addresses not yet enumerated. Grade is unknown pending evaluation slice verification of control, upgradeability, and multi-sig authorities.

evidence.shows: dSOL token mint address verified: Dso1bDeDjCQxTrWHqUUi63oBvV7Mdm6WaobLbQ7gnPQ. Token is verified in Solana token registry.
Drift Staked SOL stake pool identified as 9mhGNSPArRMHpLDMSmxAvuoizBqtBGqYdT8WGuqgxNdn; pools SOL and mints dSOL token.
dSOL top holder identified: E3NiM5n6s5CKKWrrhaeVjVSTKscRrysCtZeXnxn6yMgp holds 506K dSOL (~$82M). Pool shows minting authority enabled and freeze authority disabled.
Two audit firms listed: Neodyme and Trail of Bits. Audit reports linked in drift-labs/audits repository.
Primary GitHub repository for Drift Protocol V2 (Rust/Anchor-based Solana programs). Apache 2.0 licensed. Open-source perpetuals DEX codebase.

April 2, 2026 exploit: $4.5M DSOL affected in vaults via durable nonce abuse. DSOL tokens not deposited in Drift (staked to validator) were unaffected. Drift validator program identified as separate control surface.
Official Drift documentation site. Menu shows 'Program & Vault Addresses' section and 'Audits' section under Risk and Safety. Trail of Bits audit report referenced.

D6: Factory enumeration not applicable; single pool design confirmed.

protocol_metadata.about: Drift Staked SOL (dSOL) is a liquid staking token on Solana enabling users to earn staking rewards while maintaining liquidity for DeFi participation. Users deposit SOL into the Drift Protocol's designated stake pool and receive dSOL tokens representing their staked position. The underlying SOL is delegated to validators on the Solana network, with rewards automatically accruing via an exchange-rate model rather than rebasing.
